t: 中国将领张玄夺取了北京的控制权并恢复了君主制,安放了清朝末代皇帝溥仪入朝. 两周后,共和党军队…
te: Chinese General Zhang Xun seizes control of Beijing and restores the monarchy, installing Puyi, last emperor of the Qin…
dz: 中国将领张玄夺取了北京的控制权并恢复了君主制,安放了清朝末代皇帝溥仪入朝. 两周后,共和党军队重新控制了首都,修复工作被逆转.
de: Chinese General Zhang Xun seizes control of Beijing and restores the monarchy, installing Puyi, last emperor of the Qing dynasty, to the throne. The restoration is reversed just shy of two weeks later, when Republican troops regain control of the capital.

t: 索姆河战役的第一天：索姆河战役的第一天，19,000 名英国陆军士兵阵亡，40,000 人受伤。
te: First day on the Somme: On the first day of the Battle of the Somme 19,000 soldiers of the British Army are killed and …
dz: 第一次世界大战：索姆河战役的第一天：索姆河战役的第一天，19,000 名英国陆军士兵阵亡，40,000 人受伤。
de: World War I: First day on the Somme: On the first day of the Battle of the Somme 19,000 soldiers of the British Army are killed and 40,000 wounded.

t: 当时的德国德国空军陆军航空队的库尔特·温特根斯 (Kurt Wintgens) 中尉使用同步机…
te: Leutnant Kurt Wintgens of the then-named German Deutsches Heer's Fliegertruppe army air service achieves the first know…
dz: 第一次世界大战：当时的德国德国空军陆军航空队的库尔特·温特根斯 (Kurt Wintgens) 中尉使用同步机枪武装战斗机福克 M.5K/MG Eindecker 取得了已知的第一次空中胜利​​。
de: World War I:  Leutnant Kurt Wintgens of the then-named German Deutsches Heer's Fliegertruppe army air service achieves the first known aerial victory with a synchronized machine-gun armed fighter plane, the Fokker M.5K/MG Eindecker.

t: 德国向摩洛哥派遣了"快艇"(SMS Panther),引发了"阿加迪尔危机".
te: Germany dispatches the gunboat SMS Panther to Morocco, sparking the Agadir Crisis.
dz: 德国向摩洛哥派遣了"快艇"(SMS Panther),引发了"阿加迪尔危机".
de: Germany dispatches the gunboat SMS Panther to Morocco, sparking the Agadir Crisis.

t: SOS作为国际求救信号被采纳.
te: SOS is adopted as the international distress signal.
dz: SOS作为国际求救信号被采纳.
de: SOS is adopted as the international distress signal.

t: 首届法国巡回自行车赛开始.
te: Start of first Tour de France bicycle race.
dz: 首届法国巡回自行车赛开始.
de: Start of first Tour de France bicycle race.

t: 圣胡安山战役在古巴圣地亚哥进行。
te: The Battle of San Juan Hill is fought in Santiago de Cuba, Cuba.
dz: 西班牙-美国战争：圣胡安山战役在古巴圣地亚哥进行。
de: Spanish–American War: The Battle of San Juan Hill is fought in Santiago de Cuba, Cuba.

t: 加拿大和百慕大通过电报电缆连接。
te: Canada and Bermuda are linked by telegraph cable.
dz: 加拿大和百慕大通过电报电缆连接。
de: Canada and Bermuda are linked by telegraph cable.

t: 美国终止同加拿大的互惠和渔业协定.
te: The United States terminates reciprocity and fishery agreement with Canada.
dz: 美国终止同加拿大的互惠和渔业协定.
de: The United States terminates reciprocity and fishery agreement with Canada.

t: 刚果自由国由比利时国王利奥波德二世建立.
te: The Congo Free State is established by King Leopold II of Belgium.
dz: 刚果自由国由比利时国王利奥波德二世建立.
de: The Congo Free State is established by King Leopold II of Belgium.

t: 世界上第一个国际电话是在加拿大新不伦瑞克州圣斯蒂芬和美国缅因州加来之间拨打的.
te: The world's first international telephone call is made between St. Stephen, New Brunswick, Canada, and Calais, Maine, U…
dz: 世界上第一个国际电话是在加拿大新不伦瑞克州圣斯蒂芬和美国缅因州加来之间拨打的.
de: The world's first international telephone call is made between St. Stephen, New Brunswick, Canada, and Calais, Maine, United States.

t: 第70号通令是英国陆军卡德韦尔和童子军改革的高潮,生效.
te: General Order 70, the culmination of the Cardwell and Childers reforms of the British Army, comes into effect.
dz: 第70号通令是英国陆军卡德韦尔和童子军改革的高潮,生效.
de: General Order 70, the culmination of the Cardwell and Childers reforms of the British Army, comes into effect.

t: 查尔斯·塔泽·罗素出版"宗教"杂志"守望台"的第一版.
te: Charles Taze Russell publishes the first edition of the religious magazine The Watchtower.
dz: 查尔斯·塔泽·罗素出版"宗教"杂志"守望台"的第一版.
de: Charles Taze Russell publishes the first edition of the religious magazine The Watchtower.

t: 加拿大加入万国邮政联盟。
te: Canada joins the Universal Postal Union.
dz: 加拿大加入万国邮政联盟。
de: Canada joins the Universal Postal Union.

t: Sholes和Glidden打字机是第一台商业上成功的打字机,继续销售.
te: The Sholes and Glidden typewriter, the first commercially successful typewriter, goes on sale.
dz: Sholes和Glidden打字机是第一台商业上成功的打字机,继续销售.
de: The Sholes and Glidden typewriter, the first commercially successful typewriter, goes on sale.

t: 爱德华王子岛加入加拿大联邦.
te: Prince Edward Island joins into Canadian Confederation.
dz: 爱德华王子岛加入加拿大联邦.
de: Prince Edward Island joins into Canadian Confederation.

t: 美国司法部正式成立。
te: The United States Department of Justice formally comes into existence.
dz: 美国司法部正式成立。
de: The United States Department of Justice formally comes into existence.

t: 随着加拿大省,新不伦瑞克省和新斯科舍省加入联邦以创建现代的加拿大国家,"英属北美法案"生效. …
te: The British North America Act takes effect as the Province of Canada, New Brunswick, and Nova Scotia join into confeder…
dz: 随着加拿大省,新不伦瑞克省和新斯科舍省加入联邦以创建现代的加拿大国家,"英属北美法案"生效. 约翰·A·麦克多纳德宣誓就任加拿大第一任总理. 这个日期在加拿大每年被作为国家节日加拿大日来纪念.
de: The British North America Act takes effect as the Province of Canada, New Brunswick, and Nova Scotia join into confederation to create the modern nation of Canada. John A. Macdonald is sworn in as the first Prime Minister of Canada. This date is commemorated annually in Canada as Canada Day, a national holiday.

t: 美国内战:葛底斯堡战役开始.
te: The Battle of Gettysburg begins.
dz: 美国内战:葛底斯堡战役开始.
de: American Civil War: The Battle of Gettysburg begins.

t: 在荷兰殖民地苏里纳姆废除了奴隶制,这个日期后来被庆祝为独立苏里南的克蒂科蒂.
te: Slavery is abolished in the Dutch colony of Surinam, a date subsequently celebrated as Ketikoti in independent Suriname.
dz: 在荷兰殖民地苏里纳姆废除了奴隶制,这个日期后来被庆祝为独立苏里南的克蒂科蒂.
de: Slavery is abolished in the Dutch colony of Surinam, a date subsequently celebrated as Ketikoti in independent Suriname.

t: 俄罗斯国家图书馆是作为莫斯科公共博物馆图书馆而成立的.
te: The Russian State Library is founded as the Library of the Moscow Public Museum.
dz: 俄罗斯国家图书馆是作为莫斯科公共博物馆图书馆而成立的.
de: The Russian State Library is founded as the Library of the Moscow Public Museum.

t: 马尔文山战役进行. 这是"七日之战"中的最后一场,是乔治·B·麦克莱兰的"半岛运动"的一部分.
te: The Battle of Malvern Hill takes place. It is the last of the Seven Days Battles, part of George B. McClellan's Peninsu…
dz: 美国内战:马尔文山战役进行. 这是"七日之战"中的最后一场,是乔治·B·麦克莱兰的"半岛运动"的一部分.
de: American Civil War: The Battle of Malvern Hill takes place. It is the last of the Seven Days Battles, part of George B. McClellan's Peninsula Campaign.

t: 英国公主爱丽丝是维多利亚女王的次女,她嫁给了黑森的路易王子,未来的路易四世,黑森大公.
te: Princess Alice of the United Kingdom, second daughter of Queen Victoria, marries Prince Louis of Hesse, the future Loui…
dz: 英国公主爱丽丝是维多利亚女王的次女,她嫁给了黑森的路易王子,未来的路易四世,黑森大公.
de: Princess Alice of the United Kingdom, second daughter of Queen Victoria, marries Prince Louis of Hesse, the future Louis IV, Grand Duke of Hesse.

t: 向伦敦林奈学会联合朗读查尔斯·达尔文和阿尔弗雷德·拉塞尔·华莱士关于进化论的论文。
te: Joint reading of Charles Darwin and Alfred Russel Wallace's papers on evolution to the Linnean Society of London.
dz: 向伦敦林奈学会联合朗读查尔斯·达尔文和阿尔弗雷德·拉塞尔·华莱士关于进化论的论文。
de: Joint reading of Charles Darwin and Alfred Russel Wallace's papers on evolution to the Linnean Society of London.

t: 昆厄尔和克勒特将土地割让给美国.
te: The Quinault and the Quileute cede their land to the United States.
dz: 签署"昆厄尔条约":昆厄尔和克勒特将土地割让给美国.
de: Signing of the Quinault Treaty: The Quinault and the Quileute cede their land to the United States.

t: 托马斯·伦普里耶和詹姆斯·克拉克·罗斯为测量潮汐变化在凡·迪门地的"死地"岛上刻了一块地标,这…
te: Thomas Lempriere and James Clark Ross carve a marker on the Isle of the Dead in Van Diemen's Land to measure tidal vari…
dz: 托马斯·伦普里耶和詹姆斯·克拉克·罗斯为测量潮汐变化在凡·迪门地的"死地"岛上刻了一块地标,这是海平面升高最早幸存的基准之一.
de: Thomas Lempriere and James Clark Ross carve a marker on the Isle of the Dead in Van Diemen's Land to measure tidal variations, one of the earliest surviving benchmarks for sea level rise.

t: 英格兰和威尔士建立了出生、婚姻和死亡民事登记制度.
te: A system of civil registration of births, marriages and deaths is established in England and Wales.
dz: 英格兰和威尔士建立了出生、婚姻和死亡民事登记制度.
de: A system of civil registration of births, marriages and deaths is established in England and Wales.

t: 危地马拉、萨尔瓦多、洪都拉斯、尼加拉瓜和哥斯达黎加这五个中美洲国家在前一年被墨西哥第一帝国吞并…
te: The five Central American nations of Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua, and Costa Rica declare independence f…
dz: 危地马拉、萨尔瓦多、洪都拉斯、尼加拉瓜和哥斯达黎加这五个中美洲国家在前一年被墨西哥第一帝国吞并后宣布独立。
de: The five Central American nations of Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua, and Costa Rica declare independence from the First Mexican Empire after being annexed the year prior.

t: 约翰·格奥尔格·特拉勒斯发现了1819年的大彗星(C/1819 N1). 这是弗朗索瓦·阿拉戈…
te: Johann Georg Tralles discovers the Great Comet of 1819 (C/1819 N1). It is the first comet analyzed using polarimetry, b…
dz: 约翰·格奥尔格·特拉勒斯发现了1819年的大彗星(C/1819 N1). 这是弗朗索瓦·阿拉戈用极地测量法分析的第一颗彗星.
de: Johann Georg Tralles discovers the Great Comet of 1819 (C/1819 N1). It is the first comet analyzed using polarimetry, by François Arago.

t: 美国私家侦探袭击了英国新斯科舍州吕南堡的定居点.
te: American privateers attack the British settlement of Lunenburg, Nova Scotia.
dz: 对吕南堡的突击:美国私家侦探袭击了英国新斯科舍州吕南堡的定居点.
de: Raid on Lunenburg: American privateers attack the British settlement of Lunenburg, Nova Scotia.

t: 莱克赛尔的彗星比有记录的历史上任何其他彗星都更接近地球,接近0.0146天文单位(2,180,…
te: Lexell's Comet is seen closer to the Earth than any other comet in recorded history, approaching to a distance of 0.014…
dz: 莱克赛尔的彗星比有记录的历史上任何其他彗星都更接近地球,接近0.0146天文单位(2,180,000公里;1,360,000米).
de: Lexell's Comet is seen closer to the Earth than any other comet in recorded history, approaching to a distance of 0.0146 astronomical units (2,180,000 km; 1,360,000 mi).

t: 法国青年贵族弗朗索瓦-让·德·拉巴尔因在阿布维尔未向天主教宗教游行队伍行礼，被施以酷刑并斩首。…
te: François-Jean de la Barre, a young French nobleman, is tortured and beheaded before his body is burnt on a pyre along w…
dz: 法国青年贵族弗朗索瓦-让·德·拉巴尔因在阿布维尔未向天主教宗教游行队伍行礼，被施以酷刑并斩首。他的躯干被钉上一册伏尔泰的《哲学辞典》，随后遗体连同书籍一起在柴堆上焚烧。
de: François-Jean de la Barre, a young French nobleman, is tortured and beheaded before his body is burnt on a pyre along with a copy of Voltaire's Dictionnaire philosophique nailed to his torso for the crime of not saluting a Roman Catholic religious procession in Abbeville, France.

t: 卢森堡元帅在弗勒鲁斯战役中战胜英荷军队。
te: Marshal de Luxembourg triumphs over an Anglo-Dutch army at the battle of Fleurus.
dz: 大联盟之战：卢森堡元帅在弗勒鲁斯战役中战胜英荷军队。
de: War of the Grand Alliance: Marshal de Luxembourg triumphs over an Anglo-Dutch army at the battle of Fleurus.

t: 爱尔兰博因河之战（按照儒略历计算）。
te: Battle of the Boyne in Ireland (as reckoned under the Julian calendar).
dz: 光荣革命：爱尔兰博因河之战（按照儒略历计算）。
de: Glorious Revolution: Battle of the Boyne in Ireland (as reckoned under the Julian calendar).

t: 威斯敏斯特议会的第一次会议,一个神学家会("divines")和被任命重组英格兰教会的英格兰议…
te: First meeting of the Westminster Assembly, a council of theologians ("divines") and members of the Parliament of Englan…
dz: 威斯敏斯特议会的第一次会议,一个神学家会("divines")和被任命重组英格兰教会的英格兰议会议员,在伦敦的威斯敏斯特会所.
de: First meeting of the Westminster Assembly, a council of theologians ("divines") and members of the Parliament of England appointed to restructure the Church of England, at Westminster Abbey in London.

t: 波兰王国和立陶宛大公国确认真正的联盟；这个统一的国家称为波兰立陶宛联邦或两国共和国。
te: The Kingdom of Poland and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania confirm a real union; the united country is called the Polish–Li…
dz: 卢布林联盟：波兰王国和立陶宛大公国确认真正的联盟；这个统一的国家称为波兰立陶宛联邦或两国共和国。
de: Union of Lublin: The Kingdom of Poland and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania confirm a real union; the united country is called the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth or the Republic of Both Nations.

t: 在前一年的索尔韦·莫斯战役中被击败后,苏格兰人与英格兰王国缔结了"格林尼治和约". 在其中,他…
te: Having been defeated in the Battle of Solway Moss in the previous year, the Scots conclude the peace Treaty of Greenwic…
dz: 在前一年的索尔韦·莫斯战役中被击败后,苏格兰人与英格兰王国缔结了"格林尼治和约". 在其中,他们还同意了婴儿玛丽王后与亨利八世之子爱德华王子的婚姻.
de: Having been defeated in the Battle of Solway Moss in the previous year, the Scots conclude the peace Treaty of Greenwich with the Kingdom of England. In it, they also agree to a marriage between the infant Queen Mary and Prince Edward, son of Henry VIII.

t: Jan van Essen 和 Hendrik Vos 成为第一批路德教殉道者，被布鲁塞尔的罗…
te: Jan van Essen and Hendrik Vos become the first Lutheran martyrs, burned at the stake by Roman Catholic authorities in B…
dz: Jan van Essen 和 Hendrik Vos 成为第一批路德教殉道者，被布鲁塞尔的罗马天主教当局烧死在火刑柱上。
de: Jan van Essen and Hendrik Vos become the first Lutheran martyrs, burned at the stake by Roman Catholic authorities in Brussels.

t: 由埃尔南·科尔特斯率领的西班牙征服者在天黑后出征特诺克蒂特兰.
te: Spanish conquistadors led by Hernán Cortés fight their way out of Tenochtitlan after nightfall.
dz: 由埃尔南·科尔特斯率领的西班牙征服者在天黑后出征特诺克蒂特兰.
de: Spanish conquistadors led by Hernán Cortés fight their way out of Tenochtitlan after nightfall.

t: 拉希格鲁埃拉战役(英语:Battle of La Higeruela)发生在格拉纳达,导致卡斯…
te: The Battle of La Higueruela takes place in Granada, leading to a modest advance of the Kingdom of Castile during the Re…
dz: 拉希格鲁埃拉战役(英语:Battle of La Higeruela)发生在格拉纳达,导致卡斯蒂利亚王国在收复战争期间略为推进.
de: The Battle of La Higueruela takes place in Granada, leading to a modest advance of the Kingdom of Castile during the Reconquista.

t: 由塔兰托王子波希蒙德所率领的十字军击败了苏丹克利杰·阿尔斯兰一世所率领的塞尔柱克军队.
te: Crusaders led by prince Bohemond of Taranto defeat a Seljuk army led by sultan Kilij Arslan I.
dz: 多里莱姆战役:由塔兰托王子波希蒙德所率领的十字军击败了苏丹克利杰·阿尔斯兰一世所率领的塞尔柱克军队.
de: Battle of Dorylaeum: Crusaders led by prince Bohemond of Taranto defeat a Seljuk army led by sultan Kilij Arslan I.

t: 纳尔斯手下的拜占庭部队在意大利击败了奥斯特罗哥特人,而奥斯特罗哥特国王托蒂拉也受了致命伤.
te: Byzantine forces under Narses defeat the Ostrogoths in Italy, and the Ostrogoth king, Totila, is mortally wounded.
dz: 塔吉纳埃战役:纳尔斯手下的拜占庭部队在意大利击败了奥斯特罗哥特人,而奥斯特罗哥特国王托蒂拉也受了致命伤.
de: Battle of Taginae: Byzantine forces under Narses defeat the Ostrogoths in Italy, and the Ostrogoth king, Totila, is mortally wounded.

t: 提比略·朱利叶斯·亚历山大命令他在亚历山德里亚的罗马军团宣誓效忠于威斯巴西亚为皇帝.
te: Tiberius Julius Alexander orders his Roman legions in Alexandria to swear allegiance to Vespasian as Emperor.
dz: 提比略·朱利叶斯·亚历山大命令他在亚历山德里亚的罗马军团宣誓效忠于威斯巴西亚为皇帝.
de: Tiberius Julius Alexander orders his Roman legions in Alexandria to swear allegiance to Vespasian as Emperor.
